svg.title: Agentic Chip Design — concept architecture
svg.desc: Vector reconstruction of the selected four-column concept illustration. It shows evidence preparation, analysis and optimization roles, PyCircuit design, evaluation and feedback, shared knowledge and ecosystem. This is a concept view, not an implementation-status claim; the project contract and roadmap remain authoritative.
svg.text: From design intent to measurable improvement, with AI agents.
Connect design, tools, and domain knowledge.
Let agents explore. Let data decide.
“Optimize BOOM’s issue unit for higher IPC”
Collect, clean and organize all relevant
Data-driven feedback to guide the next iteration.
Turn individual optimizations into reusable knowledge.
Leverage and integrate the best open-source tools.
